description: This Java class, DittoEncodingHelper, provides utility methods for percent-encoding and decoding special characters used in Ditto protocol parts such as names, IDs, and features. It handles specific characters that require escaping in URLs and protocol messages, although it is marked as deprecated. The class includes static methods for encoding and decoding strings based on predefined mappings.

classes.name: DittoEncodingHelper
classes.description: Utility class for encoding and decoding special characters used in Ditto protocol components. It is marked as deprecated and contains static methods for percent-encoding and decoding strings.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string by replacing specific special characters with their percent-encoded equivalents.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a string by replacing percent-encoded sequences with their original characters.
